name: Vase with Dished Mouth and Ascending Lotus-Petal Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；late 10th-11th century；Yue ware: light gray stoneware with celadon glaze over incised, carved, and applique decoration. Probably from the Yue kilns at Shanglinhu, Zhejian province.
